question: Why is additional purification not required when there is no contact with saliva?
premises: Impurity may arise from saliva contact
In this case there is no such contact
Purification is required only when impurity occurs
inference: Because there is no saliva contact, additional purification is not required.
uncertainties: The exact force of the double negation in śuddhirna na hīṣyate is slightly ambiguous.
plain_english: Because there is no contact with saliva, purity is not lost there and no further purification is required.
